# The RTL-to-GDSII Flow

## Concepts

Standard cells, process design kits, constraints, and the stages from RTL to physical layout.

## Implementation

Define the inputs and deliverables for implementing a RISC-V design as an ASIC.

## Hands-on Experiments

Inspect flow artifacts and establish reproducible area and timing baselines.

For each experiment, record the tool versions, design configuration, commands, inputs, expected results, and observed results.
